profiles.description: Use AAOP instructions with the developer's existing host and no external integration.
Use native AI IDE tools, subagents/workers, sandbox and approvals before adding another framework.
upgrade_triggers: runtime or execution-continuity limitations are material

profiles.description: Add Skills or MCP only for a concrete missing capability. These are independent extensions, not a mandatory bundle.
upgrade_triggers: resource provider is unknown across a broad ecosystem
dedicated runtime or execution control is justified

profiles.description: Use open discovery/interoperability standards when local knowledge and preconfigured providers are insufficient.
upgrade_triggers: long-horizon execution needs a dedicated harness or execution-control plane

profiles.description: Select the minimum specialized runtime or execution-control provider whose primary mechanism matches a proven gap. LoopX is for durable bounded execution continuity; Deep Agents is for long-horizon agent runtime capability; agency-orchestrator is for bounded Task Pod DAG/resume execution. Do not install all runtimes.
upgrade_triggers: multiple people/agents/runtimes need durable shared governance

profiles.description: Add an organizational control plane only when shared ownership, approvals, permissions, audit and scheduling are real requirements.

selection_rule: Prefer the lowest level that can satisfy the outcome with acceptable reliability and risk; levels are not mandatory or strictly cumulative. For Level 4, classify the primary missing mechanism before selecting a provider and avoid overlapping runtimes/control planes without separate proven gaps.
